Implemented the Rust (std-only) Cargo project under `output/` with the required `ical` CLI and subcommands:

- `output/Cargo.toml` (empty `[dependencies]`)
- `output/src/main.rs` (CLI + error handling + JSON output)
- `output/src/ics.rs` (ICS unfolding + parsing + typed component decoding + warnings)
- `output/src/expand.rs` (window parsing + recurrence expansion + VTIMEZONE-based TZID resolution + overrides handling + warnings)
- `output/src/json.rs` (stable JSON serialization without serde)
- `output/src/types.rs` (all mandatory schema structs)

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`
